infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Garuda A.S.T.R.A requires location access to stream field telemetry and match proximity alerts.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Garuda A.S.T.R.A requires background location access to track tactical units during active duty.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Garuda A.S.T.R.A requires location access to stream telemetry to the tactical dashboard.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Garuda A.S.T.R.A to use your location for tactical field telemetry.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Allow Garuda A.S.T.R.A to track your position in the background during active duty.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Garuda A.S.T.R.A to access your location when using the tactical terminal.
